about.label: About
about.story1: I didn't start my career in tech. After several years in different industries, I decided to pivot and go all-in on software development. I completed my Higher National Diploma (HND) in Multi-platform Software Development at ILERNA while building real-world products on the side.
about.story2: Today, I manage an e-commerce platform in production, an open-source restaurant management system, and two native Android apps. To further deepen my craft and master the fundamentals, I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Engineering at UNED.
about.story3: I work comfortably across the full stack and native mobile. My focus is on building resilient software that thrives in production, not just demos that run on localhost.
about.trait1: Production-grade delivery — products with Redsys payments, ERP integration, and real customer traffic.
about.trait2: Clean architectures — Clean Architecture, MVVM, and solid patterns across all my projects.
about.trait3: Full-cycle developer — design, development, deployment, and maintenance. I can ship to production without external dependencies.
about.trait4: Product mindset — code is a means, not the end. I build things people actually use.
about.beyondText: Board-game nerd, compulsive anime watcher, and epic-fantasy reader. If your stack includes strong coffee and Tolkien debates, we will get along.

items.details: Leading the digital transformation: Odoo ERP rollout, corporate web portal (Next.js, Firebase), and system integrations. Linux and Windows Server administration, GCP + Docker infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and network/security configuration for full-stack and mobile products.
Founded and managed a social startup focused on refurbished hardware. Built and operated the e-commerce business, logistics, and customer technical support.
Managed international logistics operations, coordinated suppliers, and optimized routes.

items.paredes: Production-grade e-commerce for industrial vehicles and machinery featuring Redsys gateway (Card & Bizum), Google OAuth, and real-time Odoo ERP synchronization for automated inventory management.
items.mmcreampro: Production e-commerce for a massage cream product line. Built with Next.js and Firebase, featuring Redsys payments, order management, and Correos API logistics integration.
items.disherio: Open-source, self-hosted restaurant management suite. Featuring QR-code ordering, real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS), and a multi-role POS (Admin, Waitstaff, Kitchen, and Cashier). Supports menu management with variants/allergens and flexible local or cloud deployment.
items.timetutor: Native Android app for private tutoring management. Interactive calendar, attendance tracking, automatic invoicing, push notifications, offline sync, and dedicated teacher/student roles.
items.episodeo: Personal TV-series tracker for Android with TMDB search, smart lists (watching, pending, finished, abandoned), list sharing via codes, offline-first cache, and theme switching. Built with Clean Architecture + MVVM.
